description:
The newest rising star captivating all of South Korea: Kim Younghan.\
Ji-ye, a film section journalist, desperately wanted to pretend she didn’t know him.\
"Hi, I’m..."\
"...Sunbae Ji-ye?"\
"Ji-ye, didn’t you just say you didn’t know Kim Younghan?"
Back in college, he was the junior who almost threw himself at her while drunk...\
How is she supposed to say she came here to interview him?\
"If you don’t have a boyfriend, how about me?"\
"Want to do it with me?"\
"That’s not what I meant at all!"\
"So what? You’re into me, aren’t you?"
